text: The property experienced three supported tree-cover loss events after 2020: 81.3 ha in 2021 (planted forest context), 0.6 ha in 2022 (mixed context), and 4.5 ha in 2023 (planted forest context). No events in this period were contradicted. The 2021 event, the largest, had high agreement (0.98) with JRC data, while the 2023 event showed perfect agreement (1.0). Smaller patches of loss (<0.5 ha) were excluded from these counts. Pre-2021 events were either contradicted or fell outside the claim interval. While the losses are corroborated, their cause, legality, or responsibility cannot be determined from this evidence alone.
